subject: Post-call: urgent capacity pathing and Hosted->Dedicated/Private decision
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Rohit Singh <j.singh@acme-payments.com>, ops@acme-payments.com
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + immediate capacity asks (Hosted vs Dedicated/Private)

Thanks for the call earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move fast. Appreciate Rohit, your ops team, and Connor/Laura for joining.

Summary of incident:
- Timeline: spike began 2026-06-19 23:45 UTC and peaked 06-20 00:25 UTC.
- Observed impact: sustained 3x increase in concurrent calls to our hosted endpoint, 95th latency jumped from ~180ms to ~1.1s; a small percentage of requests hit our retry guards and returned 503s.
- Root cause (prelim): traffic burst pattern + long LLM response tails for some long-context customers; current hosted pool hit burst limits and fallback throttles kicked in.

What we discussed:
- Short-term mitigation (minutes-hours): traffic shaping at your API gateway, temporary key-based rate caps for non-critical endpoints.
- Medium-term (days): Provision a Dedicated capacity pool or a Private VPC deployment depending on security/compliance needs. Dedicated provides fastest time-to-provision and isolation; Private/VPC is needed if you require customer-managed networking and on-prem constraints.

Immediate asks from Acme for Redwood to action:
1) Can you confirm peak RPS during the spike and current expected peak for next 30 days? (ops asked for numbers so we can size)
2) Do you have any hard security blockers that force a Private/VPC (KMS, on-prem audit, data residency)?
3) If you want Dedicated now, we can provision a trial pool (48-72hr lead) while we complete SOC2 evidence and contracting. Need PO/commit to start provisioning.

Attached: incident-metrics-20260620.csv (traffic and latency slices).

Next internal steps for Redwood team (Connor/Laura): prepare dedicated-quote and a quick provisioning checklist; Connor to give cost/time estimate.

Thanks — I’m on call all weekend if needed.

—
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Rohit Singh <j.singh@acme-payments.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme-payments.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + immediate capacity asks (Hosted vs Dedicated/Private)

Thanks Neha — good write-up. Quick answers from our side:
- Peak observed: ~2,100 concurrent r/s at peak (around 00:20 UTC), sustained ~900 r/s for ~45 minutes after the peak.
- Expected growth: planned marketing push on July 1 likely to increase baseline qps by ~30-40%. We need headroom for 2x baseline for the next 90 days.
- Security: we require envelope encryption with customer-managed keys (KMS) and audit logs; we prefer VPC peering for the private option but can accept Dedicated if it meets KMS and audit requirements quickly.

Operational constraints: we cannot wait more than 7 business days for a mitigation that leaves us exposed to repeated throttles. Finance is okay with a short-term PO for a trial, but they need an invoice and a draft SOW.

I’ll loop in our procurement if you can send the quote and a one-pager on what Dedicated will provision.

—
Rohit Singh
VP, Engineering Ops
Acme Payments
j.singh@acme-payments.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rohit Singh <j.singh@acme-payments.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + immediate capacity asks (Hosted vs Dedicated/Private)

Neha / Laura — quick internal note on sizing and remediation options before we reply to Rohit: 
- Based on the CSV and reported peaks, I’d recommend a Dedicated pool sized for 3x current baseline with autoscaling headroom to handle short bursts. That gives Acme ~2 weeks of buffer beyond the July push.
- Cost estimate (ballpark): Dedicated trial pool (2x 8-GPU nodes, preemptible mix) ~$45k/month; hourly burn for trial ~ $3k/day while active.
- Timeline: we can stand up a trial Dedicated pool in ~48-72 hours after PO + infra prep (VPC peering adds 1-2 business days).
- For security: we support customer-managed KMS and can enable audit log forwarding. Private/VPC full install (customer control plane) would take ~10-14 business days with procurement and an on-prem package if needed.

Recommend: offer a 7-day Dedicated trial with clear rollback/fallback and a one-page runbook for rate limiting. Ask procurement for a short PO that covers 7 days of Dedicated trial plus provisioning. I’ll prepare the quote and the runbook (attach draft).

—
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Rohit Singh <j.singh@acme-payments.com>, ops@acme-payments.com
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 07:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Next steps: Dedicated trial + procurement items

Rohit — thanks for the quick answers. Per Connor’s sizing and your security note, proposed path:
1) Short-term: 7-day Dedicated trial (48-72hr provision window). Will be configured with customer-managed KMS and audit log forwarding. No code changes required on your side; we’ll provide a temporary DNS endpoint and migration checklist.
2) Parallel: Start procurement for longer-term commitment OR confirm Private/VPC if you need customer-controlled networking. Private requires additional lead time.
3) Action items we need from Acme to start provisioning: PO for trial (line item: "Redwood Dedicated trial - Acme Payments - 7d"), point of contact for network setup, and approval to enable KMS integration.

Attached: dedicated-quote-Acme-0616.pdf (quote with hourly rates + trial discount), SOC2-summary.pdf (high level controls we will enable).

If you approve, Connor will schedule the infra kickoff and I’ll send a short SOW and invoice for the PO. Can we kick off provision Friday morning (48hrs)? If Finance needs any alternate wording on the PO, send it and I’ll get it routed.

Thanks — Neha

From: Rohit Singh <j.singh@acme-payments.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme-payments.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Dedicated trial + procurement items

Neha — confirmed. Procurement will raise a PO tonight for the 7-day trial and I’ll introduce our network engineer to your infra team for KMS/VPC setup. Please include the statement of work + invoice template in the next email. We want the Dedicated trial up before the July marketing push.

I’ll also ask Finance for an expedited approval for a longer reserved capacity conversation if the trial meets expectations.

—
Rohit Singh
VP, Engineering Ops
Acme Payments
